# Belinda

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Role:** Domestic servant  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She has freckles, a snub nose, and a broad mouth and smile. In her youth, she wore her hair in pigtails fastened with large blue ribbon bows, later adopting a massive pompadour hairstyle. She often wore starched white dresses for special events.

_Sources: [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v4 c3 P37](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0037)_

## Personality

Belinda is practical, hard-working, extremely loyal, and deeply devoted to her mistress. She possesses a matter-of-fact outlook on life, sometimes worrying excessively about practical misfortunes like bad weather or mishaps. She is naturally affectionate and supportive toward those she admires.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v2 c30 P22](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0022), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)_

- Domestic housework and cooking  <sub>[v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- To care faithfully for her mistress  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>

## History

Belinda went to live with Miss Rosalind at Echo Cottage when she was thirteen, taking on domestic duties in exchange for room, board, and garments. Because Miss Rosalind referred to all her young handmaidens as 'Belinda' to avoid confusion, she became known as Belinda the Fourth. She grew deeply attached to Miss Rosalind and entertained visitors like Nell and Isolde with great cheerfulness. When Miss Rosalind married Stephen Stanhope, Belinda helped with the wedding preparations and subsequently moved to Boston with the family in the autumn. Over time, she grew into a young woman and eventually married a American bricklayer named Tom, though she returned to attend Nell's wedding and remained devoted to her old friends.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P36](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0036), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v4 c3 P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual given name is Leonora  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the youngest daughter of Mrs. Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She went to live at Echo Cottage with Miss Rosalind at age thirteen  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Three of her elder sisters previously worked for Miss Rosalind as 'Belinda'  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> Taking everything into account, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, I haven’t come across a single person in Boston who compares to you  <sub>[v3 c40 P1](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0001)</sub>

> I certainly never believed I would descend to taking a Yankee as my husband, Miss Harcourt, ma’am  <sub>[v4 c3 P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038)</sub>
